summary: Add a read-only diagnostics collector for managed scenes, including scene/canvas geometry, embedded documents, map decoding, and green DOM/scene suspect detection, then wire it into the GM Tools application.

operations.before:
refresh: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.refresh,
      showScenes: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.showScenes,
      showComic: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.showComic,
operations.after:
refresh: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.refresh,
      showScenes: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.showScenes,
      showDiagnostics: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.showDiagnostics,
      diagnosticsRefresh: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.diagnosticsRefresh,
      diagnosticsCopy: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.diagnosticsCopy,
      showComic: OrphanedSunSceneLibrary.showComic,

operations.before:
tabScenes: this.activeTab === "scenes",
      tabComic: this.activeTab === "comic",
      comic: comicContext(this.comicDraft)
operations.after:
tabScenes: this.activeTab === "scenes",
      tabDiagnostics: this.activeTab === "diagnostics",
      tabComic: this.activeTab === "comic",
      diagnostics,
      comic: comicContext(this.comicDraft)

checks.name: Telemetry wiring present
checks.run: grep -q 'collectSceneDiagnostics' scripts/scene-library.mjs && grep -q 'greenDomCandidates' scripts/scene-diagnostics.mjs && grep -q 'greenSceneCandidates' scripts/scene-diagnostics.mjs
